scope: One prospective fixed32 Native owner-acquisition component; not MPC, model fitting, prediction, timing comparison or P2.
prior_evidence_scope: One previously accepted engineering component; all three cuts EMPTY. Never reinterpreted as inflight coverage or rerun.
completion_cap_scope: HTTP-requested completion tokens, not equality with physical issued tokens.

messages.content: Count upwards from 1, separated by spaces. Continue counting without commentary.

prompt_rationale: Prospectively fixed ordinary counting prompt, rather than the prior two-token ready response. It may still finish early; no latency or nonempty state is assumed, no EOS override/min_tokens/control retry.

inflight.trigger: Exactly0.020s after the retained managed client dispatch-attempt timestamp, not server receipt. Source acquisition may overlap this managed transport; managed transports never overlap one another.
inflight.trigger_deadline: Original active20 absolute deadline; no wait for desired queue contents.
inflight.early_completion: At the single trigger, if transport already terminal, retain early_complete_no_cut and do not manufacture another inflight sample.
inflight.acquisition: One unchanged full source-clock/process-bound native phase cut plus flushed byte-bound Gateway prefix, max source age0.5. Preserve every refusal. No source cut is resampled.
inflight.coverage: Target UUID must map through unchanged publication/lifecycle/owner joins to an actual scheduler request or actual issued-queue work. Zero-work/unattributed routes and unrelated stock remain visible but are not target coverage.
inflight.temporal: Retained managed dispatch < native source T <= collector availability/consumption < managed terminal receipt, same process-proven clock domain; actual source evidence, not task pending/intent/delay alone.
inflight.historical_overlap_only: A source T before outcome but receipt/consumption after outcome is retained separately and does not satisfy usable-inflight coverage.
inflight.post_outcome: Exactly one unchanged post-outcome cut after each received outcome, including HTTP refusal or malformed body, while the existing absolute budget permits.
inflight.success: Engineering completion and both prescribed offers have genuine source-bound target nonempty coverage available before their terminal receipts. Otherwise primary component_pass=false with separate truthful engineering/miss/partial-coverage fields.
inflight.no_adaptive_action: A valid empty/missed first cut does not alter the second frozen offer, payload or trigger. A source-contract/transport failure refuses further offers after retaining/joining the current transport and any permitted post-outcome cut.

transport_scope: New private source-derived receipt adapter: no whole-request global lock. Single owning event-loop atomic reservation, global1900 bound, duplicate managed ID refusal, immutable per-call settings and explicit per-request HTTPX timeouts. Source sync callbacks remain future-bound0.2s.
receipt_order: Sequences identify reservation order, not completion order; immutable reservation and terminal files, including cancelled/partial/unsent records. Out-of-order completions must not overwrite/drop IDs.

executor.shutdown: Explicit bounded task/client/executor cleanup, never asyncio.run unbounded default-executor shutdown; supervisor owns the whole client if a worker cannot join.

final.scope: Retain legacy failure and every full sample. End/ACK only after actual full drain and retained/fsynced/hash-checked capture, not persistent/GPU-future quiescence.

route: Source13-first, prepared-forward/light, prepared-copy-ready flag0/extension absent, existing exact phase/input-post hooks
no_retries: No repeated CAS, managed offer, inflight/post-outcome cut, end, ACK, restore or fallback. Only inherited preregistered read-only startup/final polling.
private_material: Private config0600/tmpdir0700, ASCII bytes+37<=107; parent streaming redaction; all helpers/readers joined before config deletion/export; no headers/env/private config in evidence.
